references.text: Saul also asked his armor-bearer to kill him with a sword to avoid the shame of falling into enemy hands, just as Abimelech asked his armor-bearer to kill him to avoid the shame of being killed by a woman.
Abimelech refers to his own death in 2 Samuel 1:9-10, where the young Amalekite claimed to have killed Saul at his request, in the same way that Abimelech's armor-bearer killed him.
Joab directly references Abimelech's death by a woman's hand as a well-known example of a shameful death in war.
